workResult: Completed source-complete Deep Reading for both same-date Selected objects and produced two durable Reading Notes. Q-20260909-01 read the complete KOPA-Bench/EDGE primary study plus the current linked EDGE-KOPA repository release state. The bounded finding is that schema or LLM plausibility is only a hypothesis: live executions add material evidence, can overturn priors and improve the refined dependency graph, but final graph membership is not equivalent to a one-success Boolean proof. Execution evidence is graded, contextual and perishable, and it must remain separate from call-time authorization, target binding, idempotency and effect safety. The note also records that the linked public repository currently advertises benchmark/corpus/checkpoint releases as forthcoming, so paper-level evidence is stronger than present public end-to-end reproducibility. Q-20260909-02 read the complete TruthInsightBench primary study and inspected its public benchmark/evaluator repository. The bounded finding is that execution competence and evidentiary judgment are distinct: four harnesses using the same frozen base model show relatively strong evidence auditability and novelty but very weak control testing, robustness and falsifiability, with no statistically reliable pairwise winner in the reported overall scores. The benchmark therefore supports a separate evidence-challenge gate before a technically successful analytical workflow becomes trusted organizational knowledge. Exact two-note head 7fe6ae5cc4d6ddc35afd88077884975183cd5bc4 passed the Validate Runtime Center step of Validate Research Center 3.0 run 34306457567 before terminal finalization. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication.
workResult_zh: 已对两个同日 Selected Object 完成来源完整 Deep Reading，并生成两份持久 Reading Note。Q-20260909-01 完整深读 KOPA-Bench/EDGE 一手研究，并核查当前 EDGE-KOPA 公开仓库发布状态。边界结论是：Schema 或 LLM 判断的可组合性只是候选假设；Live Execution 会提供额外信息、能够推翻先验并改善精炼后的依赖图，但最终图成员资格并不等于‘一次成功即可永久证明’。Execution Evidence 是分级、带上下文且会过期的能力证据，不能替代 Call-time Authorization、目标绑定、幂等性或 Effect Safety。笔记同时记录当前关联公开仓库仍把 Benchmark/Corpus/Checkpoint 标为即将发布，因此论文层证据强于当前公开端到端可复现性。Q-20260909-02 完整深读 TruthInsightBench 一手研究并核查其公开 Benchmark/Evaluator 仓库。边界结论是：Execution Competence 与 Evidentiary Judgment 是两种不同能力；四个使用同一冻结基础模型的 Harness 在 Evidence Auditability 与 Novelty 上相对较强，但 Control Testing、Robustness 与 Falsifiability 明显偏弱，而且论文报告的总体分数没有形成统计可靠的两两优胜关系。因此，技术流程执行成功之后仍需要独立的 Evidence-challenge Gate，才能把分析结果升级为可信组织知识。精确两份 Note Head 7fe6ae5cc4d6ddc35afd88077884975183cd5bc4 已在终态收口前通过 Validate Research Center 3.0 Run 34306457567 的 Validate Runtime Center 步骤。Reading 未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化、Production 或 Publication。
